spans: software engineer · bengaluru · web apps, end to end

readme.intro:
Hi, I'm Dileesh, a software engineer in Bengaluru.

I build web apps end to end: the database, the API and the screens in front of them. Most of my work so far has been in Go, TypeScript and Python on PostgreSQL, with React on the front.

projects.name: go-calc
projects.line: a calculator where every answer is exact, proven to guaranteed digits, an estimate with its uncertainty, or refused with the reason. One Go engine runs in the browser as WebAssembly, on the command line and over HTTP.

projects.name: XRAY
projects.line: a DevTools extension that captures fetch and XHR traffic and shows the decrypted response.

projects.name: DevNotes
projects.line: notes and snippets with ranked full-text search on PostgreSQL.

projects.name: StreakForge
projects.line: a small Go CLI for habits and streaks, kept in one local JSON file.

projects.name: Personal Finance API
projects.line: a FastAPI backend for expenses, budgets and recurring bills.

readme.after: I've also had two pull requests merged into [Cherry Studio](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio).
readme.outro: More about me at [dileeshrahul.dev](https://dileeshrahul.dev) or on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dileesh-rahul-7a659622b/).
